Cyrus: When you're ready.
The air here is torn.
Something hums on the other side.
The grass here is burned flat,
in a square. Something stood here.
The Resonator hums. The air over
the burned grass goes cold.
A crate is pried open. Inside sits
a machine with a violet shard.
It hums louder. The air in front
of it tears open.
Deep inside the tear, a Skarmory
screams. The machine keeps humming.
It's the same cry you heard in
the rift.
The hum fades. Only the burned
grass is left.
